decision: Sam's explicit decision of 2026-11-04 in Claude Code session f804490c: "全部批准，我作為project owner 批準你幫我發digest", answering the consolidated proposals for TASK-018 (2 new client test files, 26 case definitions running 38 times, and the PurchaseOrderForm.vue support pin), and a one-time project-owner authorization for the agent to publish this receipt's digest
purpose: The Purchasing client service sends eventId as Idempotency-Key and forwards AbortSignal; useCommandEvent keeps the same payload and eventId while an outcome is unknown; the PO form keeps user-changed defaults, previews amounts the same as the real server math, preserves input on field errors and version conflicts, guards dirty leave, and submits with the same eventId on retry
data: No database or network: mocked services and small inline objects. The preview cases import the real server moneyMath and quantityMath. No fixture files
thresholds: All cases pass; coverage floors unchanged
trigger: Routine correctness regression on every PR and push to main, in the existing client test job
cost: Measured locally: under 1 s for both files. CI not measured, estimated under 1 s added. No new job and no capacity
